Pinned upstream: github.com/evanw/esbuild v0.28.0. The 109 production Go files and MIT LICENSE.md are copied from that module. Import paths are mechanically rebased to this repository's third_party/esbuild namespace; compiler, parser and resolver behavior remains unchanged. One parser return stores its unchanged expression in a local variable so Go 1.26 and 1.27 agree on formatting and four upstream path examples use a generic <user> placeholder for the public export privacy guard. Only pkg/api/api.go and pkg/api/api_impl.go add the non-nil InputFiles map at native Context/rebuild filesystem construction, reusing existing fs.MockFS. Nil retains RealFS. Captured builds request no filesystem watch data or output writes.

There is no nested module or replace directive, preserving go install of the public framework. Public export rebases this repository's module-qualified imports.

ponytail: retain the small API patch until upstream exposes a finite input filesystem; then remove this vendored copy. Compare all source against pinned upstream after mechanically reversing the import rebase; only the two API files, the noted formatting-neutral local variable and comment placeholders may differ.
